workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a polygon boundary for State College borough to identify intersecting census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available polygon dataset representing the boundary of State College borough. Return the dataset metadata and artifact.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Prepare the borough boundary for a compatible spatial join with the census tract layer.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved borough boundary from its explicitly reported source CRS to EPSG:26918. Do not guess the source CRS; request clarification if it is not reported.

workflow_steps.title: Identify census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Select the census tracts that spatially intersect the State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join between the census tract layer and the reprojected State College borough boundary using an intersection relationship. Preserve the census tract identifiers and geometries needed for zonal statistics.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject elevation raster to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Align the elevation raster with the intersecting census tract zones for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the elevation raster from its reported CRS EPSG:3857 to EPSG:26918. Preserve elevation values and use an explicitly documented resampling method.

workflow_steps.title: Compute mean elevation by intersecting tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Summarize mean elevation for each census tract that intersects State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal mean elevation using the reprojected elevation raster and the intersecting census tract polygons. Preserve the census tract identifier in the CSV summary.
